source.context: Example 19 following Proposition 20, section 4.6: R embeds as a coordinate subspace of R².

mathematics: q:R→R² is x↦(x,0); its image is the subspace Y=R×{0}. The corestriction q:R→Y is a homeomorphism, whose inverse is the first coordinate projection restricted to Y.
The mathematical embedding is separate from its corestriction, so Homeomorphism is asserted onto the image subspace rather than onto all of R².

A separate substance with varying second coordinate renders x↦(0.25,x), with verified native SVG marker coordinates.
